cases.composition: Client/API entry at left; product reads above the middle; order persistence and event backbone in the middle; inventory, payment and notification on the right. Distinguish synchronous requests from event fan-out, with pale cyan and mint grouping planes.

cases.title: 知识问答：索引构建与检索生成
cases.style: intricate technical sketchbook illustration on clean warm-white paper, precise pencil and dark blue ink, pale mint and lavender watercolor washes; miniature cutaway document-processing equipment, labeled storage vessels and retrieval instruments physically joined by routing tracks; restrained irregular drawing texture, no solid dark fills
cases.composition: Two wide parallel tiers, upper offline indexing and lower online answering, sharing exactly one vector store near the right of the upper tier. Arrows show data movement: stored candidate context flows from the vector store into retrieval. Keep the authored shared dependency visible; do not duplicate the vector store or imply that a model independently creates citations.

cases.title: 即时消息：在线投递与离线通知
cases.style: bright tactile clay technical diorama, matte porcelain and soft mint, coral and sky-blue modeled service components, precise short dark-blue directional tracks, broad white studio background and soft daylight, small consistent shadows, no night scene
cases.composition: Horizontal send-to-receive path across the upper half; a distinctly separated lower branch for offline push. Place persistent storage beside the message service and session-state lookup beside the routing decision. Emphasize fan-out and the state dependency; do not collapse all services into a single serial chain.

cases.title: 视频平台：上传、转码与分发
cases.style: light silver-glass architectural cutaway illustration, clear frosted-white and ice-blue miniature processing modules with finely drawn circuitry, translucent routing tracks and legible dark blue labels; white background, diffuse high-key lighting, realistic shallow material depth; controlled cyan and muted violet accents, no black metal
cases.composition: Broad horizontal processing line; show source-video storage feeding the processing cluster separately from the queue/scheduler control path. Make the cluster an illustrated cutaway containing repeated processing units but only one shared label. Finished assets flow through distribution to a player. Place the metadata branch below the upload entrance without crossing the main data path.

cases.title: 搜索平台：采集、索引与查询
cases.style: precise engineering field-notebook illustration on warm white paper, fine dark-blue pen and restrained pencil construction lines, pale sage and lavender watercolor washes; detailed miniature web-document conveyors, parsing equipment, searchable index cabinet and retrieval instruments; crisp attached Chinese labels, no heavy paper aging
cases.composition: Two well-spaced horizontal tiers. The six offline components progress left to right across the upper tier. The six online components progress left to right below. A single, clearly separated dependency descends from the shared upper-right search index, follows the empty corridor between tiers, and enters the top of the lower retrieval component. Short direct arrows everywhere else; no duplicate index.

cases.title: 数据分析：批流处理与指标交付
cases.style: editorial scientific-atlas cutaway drawing on clean white paper; hairline graphite and navy technical contours, transparent pale-aqua and soft ochre watercolor sections, detailed instrument-like streaming processors and a warehouse cutaway; clean printed Chinese labels rather than calligraphy; measured realistic proportions, delicate restrained material texture
cases.composition: An upper real-time processing lane and lower offline analysis lane converge into one metrics service toward the right. The event stream also archives downward into object storage. Use the open corridor between lanes for that branch. Metrics service flows through a query interface to an analytics report at the right; the live metrics store has a separate short branch to alerts above the report area. Balance three regions instead of squeezing all twelve components into one row.

cases.title: 内容推荐：在线决策与行为反馈
cases.style: bright silver and translucent ice-blue glass technical cutaway, shallow physical depth, thin dark-blue outlines on glass modules, subtle violet personalisation accents, white studio background, diffuse daylight; detailed profile-card storage, vector search instrument, ranking processor and a visible filtering assembly; legible dark navy labels
cases.composition: A broad left-to-right recommendation path across the middle: client, entry, retrieval, ranking, policy filter, result. Profile service and its store sit above the entry/ranking area and visibly feed ranking. Vector index sits below retrieval and model service below ranking with short isolated dependency arrows. A separate lower feedback lane runs client to event collection to event bus, then a carefully routed upward arrow enters profile service from an outside corridor. At crossings show clear bridge separation without a junction dot. Twelve components, no extra recommendations or feedback destinations.

cases.title: 订单履约：库存、仓储与配送
cases.style: light product-launch technical diorama in pale cyan glazed ceramic and frosted blue glass, precise deep-blue routing tracks, small realistic cutaway warehouse shelves, parcel reservation bins and dispatch equipment; broad white background and soft clean shadows, restrained mint grouping planes; polished physical details that express each software responsibility
cases.composition: Use a spacious upper main chain: order entrance to fulfillment to event bus to stock reservation to warehouse scheduler to delivery. Place each of the four dependent stores or external interfaces immediately above its service with a short arrow. Put notifications and message channel in a separate lower-right region; two separate arrows enter notifications, one from event bus and one from delivery. No accidental joining of independent input lines. Keep the main architecture broad and balanced without giant generic icons.
